I've called this casting-lock meeting to finalize the three roles for our filmed stage thriller: Mara Vale, the aerial lead; Tomas Reed, the speaking co-lead; and the Narrator. Our candidates are Alex Chen, Bea Okafor, and Cy Bell. Before I make the binding cast decision, I need to follow our standard department sign-off round. Could the stunt, talent, and legal leads please report any production requirements I should be aware of?
